title: The Judgment on Samaria and Jerusalem
description: The prophet Micah of Moreshet receives the word of the Lord during the reigns of kings Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah. The Lord descends from his holy temple as a witness against the peoples; the mountains melt and the valleys split open before him. Judgment comes because of Jacob's rebellion and Judah's high places, striking both Samaria and Jerusalem. Samaria will become a heap of ruins, its idols will be smashed, and the wages of prostitution will be burned [ref: Micah 1:1-7|Micah 1:1-7].
